arguments.value: This amendment to the Wireless Content License Agreement is between Fox Mobile Entertainment, Inc., as Administrator for Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation, and Glu Mobile, Inc. f/k/a Sorrent, Inc. It gives Glu a limited, non-exclusive license to distribute additional Ice Age 2 / "Ice Age: The Meltdown" wireless products, including specified voicetones and premium videos in the United States and outside the United States. Glu must pay Fox a royalty based on gross receipts from those products, starting with the first unit sold, and may not use those sales to recoup any Ice Age 2 guarantee from a prior amendment. Glu also has no claim to any direct-to-consumer revenue Fox earns from these products. The amendment says the original agreement remains in full force and effect except as changed here, but it does not state a separate term or duration for this amendment. The source does not state any governing law.
